transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

I guess... well, my eating just went completely off the rails lately. I usually track my food, but I just stopped caring about it. I've been skipping real meals for days, mostly just living on coffee and... protein bars. I didn't really even notice until my clothes started hanging loose on me.
Have you lost more than 5% of your body weight recently without trying?

I don't know the exact percentage. Like I just said... I haven't been paying attention to any of my tracking lately. I haven't been on a scale. I just know my clothes don't fit right anymore, so... probably.
Have you been intentionally avoiding eating or keeping your weight low even though you know you're underweight?
No, not intentionally. Like I said, I just... stopped caring about it. It's not about trying to be skinny or anything. I just haven't been eating much.
Have you been worried about gaining weight or feeling like you’re too heavy, even if others might not see it that way?
No. I... I haven't been worried about that. Like I said, it's just not something I've been thinking about at all.
Have you noticed a decrease in your appetite or found yourself not interested in eating lately?

Yeah... I guess you could say that. I just... I stopped tracking everything. I've basically been living on coffee and, I don't know, protein bars for days at a time. I skip actual meals. I didn't even notice until my clothes started hanging loose on me. So, yeah... my eating just went completely off the rails.
When you say you've been skipping meals and not eating much, is it because you're not interested in food, or is it more that you actively avoid eating even when you know you should?
I just... I'm just not interested. I don't avoid it on purpose. I just don't think about it.
Have you noticed that you're not getting pleasure from things you used to enjoy, like hobbies, socializing, or other activities?

Yeah... I guess so. Like I said, I stopped logging my meals. And... I don't know, I just haven't really wanted to go hiking, or edit photos. I haven't even touched this woodworking project I have out in the garage. Usually, doing those things keeps me grounded, but... yeah. I just haven't cared.
Have you been feeling down, depressed, or hopeless most of the time lately?

Yeah... I guess you could say that. It started... well, the sponsor on my project questioned my judgment on something. After that, it was just like... the bottom dropped out. I've just been sitting in my apartment. Feeling... hollow. And ashamed. I even found myself crying over some work emails that I normally would have just handled without a second thought. So, yeah. I've been pretty down.
How long have you been feeling this way — down, hopeless, and losing interest in things you used to enjoy?
I don't know exactly... maybe about three months? Ever since that thing with the project happened. Yeah... it's been about three months.
Have you been feeling fatigued or lacking energy nearly every day?
Um... no, not really. I mean, I'm just sitting around a lot, so... I don't feel physically tired. Just... empty, I guess. But no, not like... fatigued.
Have you noticed any changes in your sleep — like trouble falling asleep, staying asleep, or sleeping much more than usual?

Yeah... I guess staying asleep has been hard. Even when I try to sleep, I just... I keep waking up at weird hours. My mind just goes right back to the deployment plan. By morning, I just feel wrecked instead of rested. So... yeah.
Have you noticed any trouble thinking clearly, concentrating, or making decisions lately?
Um... no, not really. I mean, I can think fine. I just... I haven't really had to make any big decisions lately anyway. So... no, I haven't noticed anything like that.
Have you noticed that you're moving more slowly than usual or that your thoughts feel slowed down?
No, I don't think so. I mean... I'm not moving slow. Just... staying put mostly. And my thoughts are... they're fine. Just... focused on what I need to do.
Have you found it hard to focus on tasks, follow conversations, or remember things lately?
Um... no. Like I said, my focus is fine. I remember what I need to. I just... I keep to myself mostly right now anyway, so... following conversations isn't really something I have to worry about.
Have you noticed yourself feeling restless, fidgety, or unable to sit still lately?
No... not really. I can sit still fine. I'm mostly just... sitting anyway, like I said. So, no, I don't feel restless.
Have you had any previous episodes of feeling down, hopeless, or losing interest in things you usually enjoy that lasted for at least two weeks?
No... not really. I don't remember anything like that. I've just been... fine, mostly. I don't think I've had anything last that long.
Would you say that you have lost more than 5% of your body weight in the last few months, even if it wasn’t intentional?

I don't know about the exact percentage. But... yeah. My clothes are hanging loose. I just... I stopped caring about tracking my food. I was skipping real meals for days, mostly just having coffee and... protein bars. My eating just kind of went off the rails before I really noticed.
Have you found it difficult to think clearly, concentrate, or focus on tasks lately?
I don't think so. I mean... I can focus fine if I need to. I haven't really noticed any big changes with that.
Have you felt like your thinking has slowed down or that you're unable to focus on tasks or conversations, even when you're trying to pay attention?
No, I... I just said I haven't noticed any issues with focusing. My thinking is fine.
